item.title: 'Project Hail Mary' adds to a winning streak for originality at the movies
item.description: NEW YORK (AP) — Franchise movies have been the dominant currency in Hollywood for years, but, lately, the upside of originality has been hard to miss.

item.title: Four premiers ask for greater say in superior, appeal court judge appointments
item.description: The premiers of Ontario, Quebec, Alberta and Saskatchewan are jointly calling on the federal government to give them more of a say in the appointment of judges on their superior and appeal courts.
